description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour, not the correct behaviour. It must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it; the wall exists now so the fix is provably a change. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. `execute()` half of the pair. The strongest single statement of the defect in the corpus: the run produces `print` events for 1 and 3 and none for the middle statement, while reporting zero diagnostics — the program silently does two thirds of what it says. The middle statement still emits its `instruction` marker, so the discard happens after the statement is entered, not before.
